title: Register Korea's First PC 'SE-8001' as a National Important Material
summary: A Korean personal computer called the SE-8001, developed in the early 1980s as Korea's first domestically-produced PC, is being considered for registration as a National Important Material to preserve its historical significance in Korea's technology heritage.
problem_solved: Preserves Korea's technological heritage by recognizing the SE-8001 PC as culturally significant
why_valuable: This recognition highlights Korea's early computing history and inspires national pride in domestic technological innovation during the 1980s personal computer era
